checks.name: slugify_sealed
checks.run: PYTHONPATH=/app/lib python -c 'import json; from ansible.module_utils.common.text.slugify import slugify; print(json.dumps([slugify(s) for s in [u"Zo\u00eb Quixote, 1605!", u"Cr\u00e8me Br\u00fbl\u00e9e", u"Na\u00efve  Fa\u00e7ade", u"__\u00d8resund_Bridge__", u"Ma\u00f1ana: D\u00eda 42", u"\u00c5ngstr\u00f6m Units"]]))'
